Implemented the read-only `spiral tui-replay-list` subcommand and completed verification. For input `--filter prefs --max-cases 2`, the documented output contained 2 selected cases and matched the native command. Empty/no-match behavior was compared with ordinary replay and matched status, stdout, and stderr.
